name: rustler
description_en: Safe Rust bridge for creating Erlang NIF functions
readme_excerpt: Rustler Documentation | Getting Started | Example Rustler is a library for writing Erlang NIFs in safe Rust code. That means there should be no ways to crash the BEAM (Erlang VM). The library provides facilities for generating the boilerplate for interacting with the BEAM, handles encoding and decoding of Erlang terms, and catches rust panics before they unwind into C.
